advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Make the static scan flag a module whose module-level probe is present and unconfined even when the acli gate is in a decorator/helper rather than the function body (e.g. flag decorator_list probes, or treat any test in an unconfined probe-bearing module as an offender).
evidence: tests/unit/test_live_jira_xdist_confinement.py:105: `if not _is_acli_on_path_probe(tree): continue` (module-level probe required, but per-function requires the probe inside the function)

The reference module tests/integration/test_reconcile_live_e2e.py:141 gates via a module-level `_requires_live` helper (`return which("acli") is not None`), not inside each test — it only escapes the scan because it happens to carry a module-level group pytestmark (line 71).
advisory.finding: The static policy scan misses a live-Jira test when its acli gate lives in a decorator or module-level helper rather than in the function body: `_unconfined_live_jira_tests` only appends an offender when `_is_acli_on_path_probe(node)` is true for the FUNCTION node itself (the probe call must be lexically inside the test body), so a module that reaches live Jira via a `@pytest.mark.skipif(shutil.which('acli') is None)` decorator or a shared `_requires_live()` helper, and lacks a module-level group pytestmark, passes the scan silently.
scenarios: A future live-Jira test added with `@pytest.mark.skipif(shutil.which('acli') is None, reason=...)` and no group mark, in a module without a group pytestmark, would pass this policy gate — the exact regression the gate is meant to prevent.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Reconcile the guard's credential model with each live-Jira test's actual gate (acli + JIRA_PROJECT for test_cli) or soften the docstring claim of identical conditions.
evidence: tests/_live_jira_confinement.py:41: docstring: 'the same two conditions the live tests gate on.'
tests/interfaces/facades/test_cli.py:166-172 gates on `shutil.which("acli")` and `os.environ.get("JIRA_PROJECT")`, not on JIRA_URL/JIRA_USER/JIRA_API_TOKEN.
advisory.finding: The guard's credential model (`JIRA_URL/JIRA_USER/JIRA_API_TOKEN` + acli) does not match the gate of the newly-grouped test it targets: `test_reconcile_dry_run_against_live_jira` self-skips on `acli` AND `JIRA_PROJECT` (not the three JIRA_URL/USER/TOKEN vars). The guard fires as a broad superset so it is not incorrect, but the docstring claim 'the same two conditions the live tests gate on' is inaccurate for that test and could mislead a maintainer reasoning about when the guard fires vs. when a given test actually runs.
scenarios: A machine with acli + JIRA_PROJECT set but without JIRA_URL/USER/TOKEN: the test_cli live test could run while the guard stays silent (though the e2e module's own gate would still skip).

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a rejection test for `-n>0 --dist load` (xdist's default) parallel to the worksteal case, asserting collection fails with the confinement message.
evidence: module docstring: `* ``--dist load``      -> gw0 gw0 gw1 gw1 gw2 gw2 gw3 gw3 (scattered)` and `Under ``load`` (xdist's default) and under ``worksteal`` ... the mark is parsed and then DISCARDED`
the only rejection test uses worksteal: `cp = _collect(tmp_path, "-n", "2", "--dist", "worksteal", live_env=True)` (line 185)

predicate branch under test rejects everything except loadgroup: `if dist == "loadgroup": return None` (tests/_live_jira_confinement.py:84) — a regression changing this to `if dist != "worksteal": return None` would still pass every existing test
advisory.finding: The `--dist load` scheduler — xdist's DEFAULT and explicitly documented as a mark-discarding/scattering mode — is never tested; only `--dist worksteal` is exercised for the rejection path, so a regression narrowing the guard to reject only worksteal would pass all tests while silently re-opening the `-n auto`/`load` gap the change exists to close.
advisory.suggested_fix: Add `test_parallel_load_scheduler_is_rejected_when_live_jira_env_is_present` calling `_collect(tmp_path, "-n", "2", "--dist", "load", live_env=True)` with the same `returncode != 0` + message-substring assertions as the worksteal test.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add direct unit tests importing `unconfined_live_jira_reason` / `live_jira_credentials_available` with fake config/items covering the numprocesses-bool, partial-credential (incl. creds-without-acli), and `xdist_group(name=...)` kwarg branches.
evidence: stated rationale: `Kept out of ``tests/conftest.py`` as a PURE predicate so it is directly callable and testable without spawning pytest.` (tests/_live_jira_confinement.py:21-22)
untested bool branch: `if not isinstance(numprocesses, int) or isinstance(numprocesses, bool): return None` (line 78)

untested partial-credential logic: `if not all(os.environ.get(name, "").strip() for name in _CREDENTIAL_VARS): return False` then `return shutil.which("acli") is not None` (lines 43-45) — the creds-present-but-no-acli case (the exact scenario the guard gates) is never asserted at unit level
untested kwarg branch: `names = [*marker.args, marker.kwargs.get("name")]` (line 58) — no test passes the group via `xdist_group(name="live_reconcile_e2e")`

ABSENCE: search for `unconfined_live_jira_reason` and `live_jira_credentials_available` shows the only call sites are conftest.py and the module itself — no test imports the module (`search_files _live_jira_confinement`)
advisory.finding: The predicate module is documented as a PURE predicate 'directly callable and testable without spawning pytest', but no test imports or calls it directly; its internal decision branches are only reachable via slow subprocess `--collect-only`, leaving the numprocesses-bool rejection, the partial-credential paths in `live_jira_credentials_available`, and the `xdist_group(name=...)` kwarg branch in `_grouped_node_ids` entirely unexercised.
advisory.suggested_fix: Import the module and drive `unconfined_live_jira_reason` with a lightweight fake `config` (stub `getoption`) and fake items exposing `get_closest_marker`, asserting None/message across the branch matrix; monkeypatch env + `shutil.which` to cover `live_jira_credentials_available` partial cases.
